title_en: The Suspicion Regarding the Absence of Mahdi Hadiths in the Two Sahihs - Episode 2
description_en: An episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV: The Suspicion Regarding the Absence of Mahdi Hadiths in the Two Sahihs - Episode 2.
summary: An episode addressing the doubt or claim that hadiths concerning the Mahdi are absent from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
